ticks.note: `x = x * x` reads `x` twice, so it is an absolute write (not an update); `w += w` reads its own target, so it is an absolute write too. Absolute writes run before the other region's relative `+= 1`: `x = 3 * 3 + 1 = 10`, `w = 3 + 3 + 1 = 7`. (KIELER warns that `x = x * x` looks like old relative-write syntax.)
